claim_guard: This audit was motivated by observed Caltech outcomes and by the failure of multiplicative local OOD gates. It may establish a transparent method-development mechanism and conditional robustness on this target, but it cannot serve as independent confirmation or prospective discovery.

hypothesis_cards.outcome_free_basis: Family-first rank 3; OBELiX rank 31; ESTM rank 6; no candidate outcome enters the order.
hypothesis_cards.source_derived_hypothesis: The Ge-I-Li-S-Sb formulation region is enriched for high target ionic conductivity relative to an outcome-free composition-distance- and group-size-matched region.
hypothesis_cards.prospective_falsifier: Freeze the group and matched control before target measurement; reject the proposal if its first measured representative is not superior or if the source contributes no marginal distinct-group recovery.
hypothesis_cards.mechanistic_follow_up: Measure phase identity, density/grain-boundary sensitivity, impedance spectrum, temperature-dependent conductivity, and activation energy before assigning a transport mechanism.
hypothesis_cards.evidence_status: retrospective method-development card; reporting template, not predeclared new science
